subject: Capacity signal: runway adjustment and req prioritization
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Capacity signal: runway adjustment and req prioritization

Team,

I'm sending a short read-ahead for Monday's QBR headcount checkpoint. We have a tightening runway signal from finance: the incremental hiring budget for H1 will be ~15% below the plan we shared in October. That flips a few open reqs from "green" to "needs decision."

Please review the attached heatmap and the req tracker (high level below). I need a quick prioritized list of backfills vs. new roles we should protect, and any reqs we should pause or freeze.

High-level asks:
- Confirm 3 priority backfills that remain approved (max).
- Identify 2 non-essential new reqs we can pause this quarter.
- Call out any impacts to customer delivery (Acme Analytics integration named in the heatmap).

Attachments: [Attachment: headcount_heatmap.xlsx (xlsx, 92KB)], [Attachment: req_tracker_v3.csv (csv, 18KB)]

I suggest we cover this in our Monday 10:00 QBR prep slot (30m). If you have schedule conflicts, flag them and suggest alternates.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Capacity signal: runway adjustment and req prioritization

Thanks for the packet, Sofia — reviewed quickly this morning. Two quick clarifications before Monday:

1) The Acme Analytics delivery hit: is the headcount request for Acme a hard blocker for the integration timeline, or can we scope the work down to a smaller pilot that a current PM + SE can absorb?
2) The security infra req (ID 2419) is marked as urgent in tracker but has a candidate in final loop — if we delay that, we risk postponing a compliance milestone. It may be worth protecting.

My initial read (subject to discussion): protect 2 infra/security backfills, protect the Acme-facing delivery req if we can guarantee a trimmed scope, and pause two new IC roles on the platform roadmap that don't affect immediate SLAs.

Will bring an annotated tracker to the 10:00 slot.

- Vanessa
VP, Customer Engineering

Quick thoughts after scanning the heatmap:

- Pause candidate: Platform Feature Engineer (req 3007) — this role can be deferred to H2 without materially impacting latency roadmaps.
- Protect candidate: Security Infra (req 2419) — as Vanessa noted, delaying will push out SOC-related work and may jeopardize enterprise renewals.
- Backfill priority: Support Engineer (req 2882) for Acme onboarding — we have a strong candidate pipeline, I propose an expedited decision.

If we protect 2419 and 2882 and pause 3007, that gets us within the budget delta. We should also consider a conditional freeze rule: any new reqs submitted in the next 30 days require a cross-functional signoff (Product + Sales + Finance).

I'll be in the 10:00 slot.

-Markus
Head of Infrastructure

All — outcome from the QBR headcount checkpoint / decision: thank you for the fast turnaround. Summary and clear next steps below.

Decisions (effective immediately):
1) Protect: Security Infra (req 2419) — proceed with offer approvals as needed.
2) Protect & expedite: Support Engineer (req 2882) — Laura approved an expedited offer lane; TalentCo to proceed.
3) Pause (freeze): Platform Feature Engineer (req 3007) and one new Platform IC (req 3041) — freeze for 90 days unless business-critical evidence is presented.
4) New conditional approval rule: any new reqs submitted through 2027-02-28 require signatures from Product, Finance, and Sales.

Action owners and deadlines:
- Talent acquisition (Emily / TalentCo): hold and expedite 2882; submit offer by 2026-12-06.
- Security (Markus): finalize candidate interview loop for 2419; recommend offer by 2026-12-08.
- Product Ops (Sofia): update headcount_heatmap and req_tracker; circulate updated version by 2026-11-27.
- Finance (Priyom): confirm budget window for H1 by 2026-11-30 (Priyom to confirm whether the 15% delta is firm).

If anyone sees a material delivery risk from these freezes (Acme integration, etc.), raise it in this thread with evidence and we'll reconvene for exceptions.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People & Talent
Redwood Inference
